title: 1. Container Boot & Database Auto-Migration
subtitle: How empty MySQL containers turn into 108 populated tables automatically on startup

steps.title: MySQL Container Initialization
steps.action: Creates empty `central_ledger` & `account_lookup` schemas via MYSQL_DATABASE env var and executes `01_permissions.sql`.

steps.title: Kafka Topic Provisioning
steps.action: Pre-creates Kafka event topics (`topic-transfer-prepare`, `topic-transfer-fulfil`, `topic-transfer-position-batch`) and exits (0).

steps.title: Knex.js Schema Migrations
steps.action: Executes `Migrator.migrate()` inside `src/shared/setup.js` on startup, running 50+ scripts in `src/migrations/` to build 108 tables + `migration` lock.

steps.title: Baseline Seed Data Injection
steps.action: Runs `src/seeds/` scripts populating `amountType` (SEND/RECEIVE), `ledgerAccountType`, `transferState`, and initial `Hub` participant.

title: 2. Automated TTK Provisioning Pipeline
subtitle: What ml-testing-toolkit-client-lib does before tests or Mobile Simulator transfers can work

steps.title: CLI Runner Reads Environment & Order
steps.action: Reads `default-env.json` (HUB_NAME, currency=XXX, payeefsp, payerfsp) and `collections/provisioning/master.json` (`--labels std`).

steps.title: Hub Accounts & Settlement Models
steps.action: Dispatches `hub_setup.json` requests to `central-ledger:3001` creating `HUB_MULTILATERAL_SETTLEMENT` accounts & `DEFAULTDEFERREDNET` rules.

steps.title: DFSP Onboarding, Limits & Liquidity
steps.action: Runs `participant_receiver.json` & `participant_sender.json` creating `payeefsp` & `testingtoolkitdfsp`, setting Net Debit Caps, callbacks, and funding deposits.

title: 3. Live Mobile Simulator P2P Transfer
subtitle: Behind the scenes when Pink Bank sends funds to 987654320 (Green Bank)

steps.title: Party Discovery (Phone Lookup)
steps.action: Pink Bank queries `GET /parties/MSISDN/987654320`. ALS consults `als-msisdn-oracle-svc`, routes to Green Bank mock (`mojaloop-testing-toolkit` Rule #223), which returns "Justin Pierre Trudeau" via PUT callback.

steps.title: Agreement & Cryptographic Quote
steps.action: Pink Bank sends `POST /quotes`. `quoting-service` & `quoting-service-handler` negotiate fees and Payee generates an ILP cryptographic condition (SHA-256 hash lock).

steps.title: Prepare Phase (Funds Reservation)
steps.action: Pink Bank sends `POST /transfers` with condition. `ml-api-adapter` publishes to Kafka `topic-transfer-prepare`. `central-ledger` validates NDC and marks transfer `RESERVED`.

steps.title: Fulfil & Commit Phase (Settlement)
steps.action: Green Bank returns cryptographic fulfillment (`PUT /transfers/{id}`). `central-ledger` verifies hash, marks `COMMITTED`, updates `participantPosition` balances, and `central-settlement` applies interchange fee rules.
